bounded_slice.tested_scope: Exact pinned lbx154/Argus commit 2894b434affaff3a28c1fbbcd5c39f2e7a832236, limited to argus_skill/webapi/manager_dispatch.py and only _run_triage_and_fallbacks plus _dispatch_team_mission as reached from manager_bridge.manager_message; tested whether either helper establishes reachability to manager_bounded_handoff with name_session=true while the same invocation supplies the generated root_task_id.

files.surface: _run_triage_and_fallbacks and _dispatch_team_mission, with the same-file manager_bounded_handoff definition used only as the target identity

observations: In the same pinned file, _classify_operator_turn creates root_task_id = BacklogItem.new_id() before manager_message passes that value into the two tested helpers.
_run_triage_and_fallbacks passes root_task_id to manager_triage but contains no call to manager_bounded_handoff and no name_session argument.

_dispatch_team_mission passes root_task_id to prepare_manager_execution_task and maybe_promote_to_continuous, then to enqueue_mission, but contains no call to manager_bounded_handoff and no name_session argument.

The same file defines manager_bounded_handoff with name_session defaulting to false; when name_session is true it may call _front_door_classify with root_task_id, but neither tested helper invokes this wrapper.

Therefore this exact selected surface establishes same-invocation root_task_id generation and propagation into helper callees, but it does not establish a bounded-handoff invocation with name_session=true. Indirect behavior inside imported callees was intentionally not inspected in this slice.
bounded_slice.acceptance_effect: Exact-surface negative evidence only. The pinned manager_dispatch helper implementations propagate the same generated root_task_id downstream but do not themselves invoke manager_bounded_handoff or set name_session=true, so the required conjunction remains unresolved rather than passing or failing repository-wide.
